title: arXiv License Information (arXiv policy page)
_comment: Uploaded by the owner 2026-10-02 (bean yc74) as the source for the arXiv licence vocabulary in skills/library/library-core/archiving-arxiv.md. A print-to-PDF capture of a web page, so the rendering is archived here and `source.upstream` carries the canonical URL — `archiving-web-pages` is why the URL rather than the PDF is the identity. Its own `licence` is `unknown`, not absent: arXiv's CC0 dedication on that page applies to ARTICLE METADATA, not to the policy page itself, and conflating the two is the misreading this record exists to prevent.

files.note: 4 printed pages. Page 2 carries 'How to choose a license' and the start of the licence list; page 3 the remainder, the metadata licence and the copyright-notice policy; page 4 reuse requests.

searched.where: the captured page itself (https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html), all 4 printed pages
searched.result: states the licences available to SUBMITTERS for their articles, and dedicates article METADATA to CC0 1.0; says nothing about the licence of this policy page

searched.where: the page's own footer link row (About, Help, Contact, Subscribe, Copyright, Privacy, Accessibility)
searched.result: a 'Copyright' link exists but its target was not part of this capture, so it was not read

licence.note: Not guessed. The CC0 dedication on this page governs article metadata, not arXiv's own website text. Nothing of this page is reproduced in the corpus — the skill it informs states the licence facts in its own words and cites this URL — so no licence condition is exercised by holding the capture.
